messages:
ana: Quick heads-up — scheduling a shorter all-hands next Thu 9:00am PT. Draft agenda below, please add +1s or questions.
matt: 👍 can we keep it to 45m? calendar invite shows 60 by default.
laura: prefer 45 too, with 10 for exec Q&A and 5 for product demos.
ana: Agenda (working):
- 5m quick company metrics snapshot (growth / usage)
- 10m product highlights: Redwood Optimize + Private GA plan
- 10m ops update: Dedicated capacity SLA rollout & infra hardening
- 10m research/ML: kernel selection gains & perf numbers
- 10m Q&A (live + pre-submitted)

matt: Suggest we slot the SLO changes into ops update — ops folks will want specifics.
laura: I'll present Optimize GA checklist + callouts for SDK changes. will link PRs.
evan: I can bring 99/95p latency graphs and a short note on quantization tradeoffs.
jess: Heads-up: people-ops will share the new parental leave policy (1 slide) — not a big all-hands spot but worth calling out.
ana: Good — add as a 2min mic drop in the metrics section. Also: please add any pre-submitted Qs to this thread by Tue EOD. I'll anonymize and group them.
matt: Q: should we mention the Dedicated reserved capacity pricing changes, or defer to a customer email? @laura
laura: call it out briefly + link to the customer communication draft (internal link): https://redwood.internal/docs/dedicated-pricing-draft
allhands-bot: Reminder: calendar event created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123 — RSVP please :calendar:
evan: For recordings — I'll upload the deck + raw metrics to the shared folder within 2h after the meeting. link please post here when recording is ready.
ana: Recording plan: Zoom recording + condensed transcript (15m highlights) + a 2-slide exec summary. I'll post links in #all-hands-posts after.
jess: Also requesting a short anonymous pulse after the all-hands — 2 quick q's about clarity and next steps.
matt: Action items before Tue EOD: everyone presenting add slides to /allhands/sep-deck, drop 1-line takeaways in the thread.
laura: Added my PR links in the doc. Will keep slides tight.
evan: I'll attach the perf notebook and a small code snippet for reproducing the benchmark: ```bash
python perf/run_eval.py --model redwood-llama-13b --seq 512
```
ana: Thanks all — copying execs: @matt @laura @evan. If no objections I'll finalize agenda Fri morning and open the Q&A doc. :sparkles:
matt: All good from eng side.
laura: good to go.
jess: all set from people-ops.
allhands-bot: NOTE: Recording will be stored in Drive > All-Hands > 2025-09-Redwood-Sprint. Auto-captioning enabled.
